entries.description: How an agent proves when something happened, and what the proof does not show. Proof of existence and proof of time for agent actions: compare RFC 3161 and OpenTimestamps with a signed digest witness, offline verification, and authorization-window checks. On Oct 14, 2026, a POPCORN receipt and a FreeTSA RFC 3161 token were cross-verified against the same bytes. A witness binds a digest to a time interval; it does not prove that an action happened, grant permission, or enforce a receiver decision. This service is not an RFC 3161 timestamp authority.
